label: Cut the head off the snake and the supply is cut
description: Something seen shrinking under a clamp, identified as the NSA, with the instruction to keep praying to cut the head off the snake because that cuts the supply. Given 1 December 2025 alongside the SIM card seizures.

label: The word Mecca heard repeatedly
description: Mecca heard over and over in prayer, in tongues and in English, which he says has to do with the Muslims. Given 1 December 2025 with no event attached.

label: Somebody in crypto gets pardoned
description: A figure connected with crypto and money seen being pardoned, which he says is either coming or has already happened. Given 1 December 2025.

label: A Fort Worth plot foiled because he talked too much
description: A man from Afghanistan who planned to attack people in Fort Worth, Texas but chattered too much and did not do it, which he credits to prayer for confusion in the enemy's camp. Given 30 November 2025.
